question: What percentage of women were nominated to the panel of Vice-Chairpersons in the Upper House on 20 July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **50%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 50% is the percentage of women nominated to the panel of Vice-Chairpersons in the Upper House on 20 July 2023.
 
• This nomination reflects the ongoing efforts to promote gender equality and representation in legislative bodies.
 
• Having women in key positions can contribute to more inclusive and diverse decision-making processes.
 
• The Upper House, also known as the Rajya Sabha, plays a crucial role in the legislative framework of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of India's bicameral Parliament, with members serving staggered six-year terms.
 
• Nominations to panels such as the Vice-Chairpersons are part of the internal administrative processes of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Efforts to increase women's representation in politics are crucial for achieving gender parity in governance.
 
• Gender equality in political representation is a significant step towards ensuring that the voices of all citizens are heard and considered in policymaking.
